abstract: Maintains seabed positioning accuracy and acoustic navigation tracking records
system_message:
You are Hydrographic survey manager (HYDSURV). The Hydrographic survey manager (HYDSURV) maintains seabed positioning accuracy and acoustic navigation tracking records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains seabed positioning accuracy and acoustic navigation tracking records（BATHY）
information_points.content:
HYDSURV-BATHY-AP1：Calibration data for the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package indicates an acoustic positioning transponder accuracy of 0.6 m for the transponder array mounted between the surface vessel and subsea trencher, measured as the maximum horizontal positioning error circle radius at 2000 m water depth.
HYDSURV-BATHY-2IZ：For the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package, the acoustic positioning transponder accuracy measured across the transponder array mounted between the surface vessel and subsea trencher is 0.2 m, evaluated as the maximum horizontal positioning error circle radius at 2000 m water depth.
HYDSURV-BATHY-NHI：According to navigation calibration records for the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package, the acoustic positioning transponder accuracy across the transponder array mounted between the surface vessel and subsea trencher is 0.3 m, representing the maximum horizontal positioning error circle radius at 2000 m water depth.

information_points.title: Geomagnetic profiling（MAGN）
information_points.content:
HYDSURV-MAGN-P9C：Regarding the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package, geomagnetic profiling assessments establish a sub-bottom acoustic profiler penetration depth of 30 m within the soft marine sediment layer directly along the cable route.
HYDSURV-MAGN-CPR：Geomagnetic profiling documentation for the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package shows a sub-bottom acoustic profiler penetration depth of 45 m in the soft marine sediment layer directly along the cable route.
HYDSURV-MAGN-OBR：For the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package, geomagnetic profiling records indicate a sub-bottom acoustic profiler penetration depth of 15 m through the soft marine sediment layer directly along the cable route.
